notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:2.5} deep and {cm:10} apart from 1 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:16}. Cold, wet soil rots the seed. Sow again every 2 weeks for a steady supply, until about 8 weeks before your first fall frost.
notes.care: Water evenly, especially during flowering: dry soil and days above {c:32} make flowers drop. Stay out of the rows while plants are wet, which spreads disease. No support is needed.
notes.harvest: Pick pods while slender and crisp, before the seeds bulge. Pick every few days: each sowing crops heavily for 2 to 3 weeks.
